👥 STRATEGY #1 - DON'T WAIT UNTIL TAX SEASON

THE REALITY

Most business owners don't ignore their books on purpose.

They're busy building the business.

Meeting with clients.

Managing projects.

Growing revenue.

Bookkeeping becomes something they'll "get to later."

But Toni shared something that every business owner needs to hear:

Messy books don't just create accounting problems—they create business problems.

Without clean financial records, it's difficult to answer questions like:

• Which properties are actually profitable?

• Where is cash really going?

• Can I afford my next investment?

• Am I growing... or just getting busier?

As Toni said during the podcast,

> "QuickBooks should tell you where your business has been, where it is today, and where it's going."

Without that visibility, every major decision becomes a guess.

👥 STRATEGY #2 - STAY IN YOUR ZONE OF GENIUS

WHAT TONI HAS LEARNED AFTER HELPING 300+ REAL ESTATE INVESTORS

Throughout the podcast, Toni kept coming back to one central message:

The businesses that grow the fastest aren't necessarily the ones making the most money—they're the ones making the best decisions

because they have financial clarity.

Here are three lessons she believes every investor should know.

1. DON'T WAIT UNTIL TAX SEASON

One of the biggest mistakes Toni sees is waiting until a week before taxes are due to find a bookkeeper.

By then, the stress has already started, deadlines are approaching, and cleaning up an entire year's worth of financial records

becomes a much bigger challenge than it needed to be.

Not categorizing transactions or reconciling bank statements.
